title: Integration partners, partner events, Partner API, external workforce, external bookings

env.stage: CT stage registries (PolyPortal partners, external-workforce provider, gateway mock) next to DM-X

families.name: Partner API: tokens, full sync, guards, scheduling requests, trade, RR application
Partner events: planned shifts and the partner-initiated trade
families.note: after PAPI has reported PTN-07 (PTN-08 reads its opportunity); PTN-09 holds the PEP lock ≈ 15 min

families.name: External workforce: simulator, GLN scoping, BADI external pools, external-pool tab
External bookings import tab (booking partner records)
Partner session negatives (API only, no link side effects)
Provider error strategies (CT-wide window)
families.note: after EW; launched only when windows/ct~S-CT-GWMOCK is active (steward, user OK)

roles.rule: seed presence (111/112/113) on ST_DAY: owner of the partner trade (PTN-03, 05, 07)
trade candidate, same personnel category as PH1, listed by shift-trade-candidates for PH1's ST_DAY shift
scheduling-request HP, no planning on SR_DAY
planned-shift events (seed plannings R..R+6, free on CM_DAY / NM_DAY) and RR candidate of PTN-19
planner with 1065 + 1062 (kit) and 1050 / 1070 (stays in DMSEED:Planner): BADI external pools, trade approval, RR start
replaced employee of the PTN-19 resource replacement (painted presence on RRX_DAY)

partition.note: PH1–PH3 share one personnel category (3 TS / 2 BL at 50 people)
SPX, SPN, optional ERX, 1 spare; SPX's Planblatt node receives the virtual plannings of the external bookings

windows.note: doc windows/ct~S-CT-GWMOCK, requested by the steward with the user's OK; the X20 worker holds locks/ct~gwmock for every strategy change; one gateway-mock pod serves all teams

gates.check: steward: run partner e2e-ptn-<run> exists with tenant access to DM-X (USERS, PLANNED_SHIFTS, SHIFT_REQUESTS, NOTIFICATIONS, API_GATEWAY, POMA_SHIFT_TRADE_API, POMA_OPPORTUNITY_API, POMA_SHIFT_REQUEST_API; no UI_EMBEDDING), logging ON after its last edit; an ops 'Partner' publish appears in its Debug log within 2 min (stage/run-partner)

steward: provider gate — partner simulator lists the server HPs (GET /api/external-workforce/v1/health-professionals 200, no 'providerCode mapper' 401) and gwmock.mjs strategy get answers SUCCESS / SUCCESS (stage/provider-gate)
steward: tenant GLN of DM-X set for today (S-CT-GLN after 00:00, stage/gln); without it PTN-12..15, 17, 20 are BLOCKED-data
SPX planner permissions: external_pool.book_external_pool_employee and pool.import_external_bookings true; SPN both false; SPX reaches /partner-simulator and BADI shows 'Externe Pools'
PH1..PH5, SPX, SPN logged in once (POMA user rows); tenant subjects recorded in partner-allocation.md (claim values only)
PH1 holds a swappable seed presence on ST_DAY and GET …/shift-trade-candidates for it lists PH2 and PH3
booking-partner records for DM-X exist (GET /api/private/external-bookings as SPX total ≥ 11); none → PTN-16 list part BLOCKED-data, permission part still runs

seed.note: SPX joins E2E:EXTPOOL (leave nothing: SPX keeps DMSEED:Planner for 1050 / 1070)
one login per actor, tenant subjects, gates PTN-G1 / PTN-G2
day tokens, PH2 / PH3 eligibility (PTN-G3), PH4 / PH5 free days
optional: ERX presence on RRX_DAY for PTN-19
oracles: plan-day.sh, ext-planning.sql dry read, PEP palette coordinates for PTN-09

cleanup: throw-away partners e2e-ptn-x|l|g-<tag> deleted by their scenario (verified by a list read)
external HPs e2e-ptn-<tag>-a|b|c unregistered in the simulator after PTN-20
gateway-mock strategies SUCCESS / SUCCESS (GET) before the window is released
open external bookings cancelled; scheduling request of PH4 deleted; trade of PTN-07 approved (logged) or cancelled
the run partner is never edited; the steward deletes it after the last reader (swap F, booking NT, partner PE)
SPX membership restored only if the env is reused
